note: Stałe miejsca w małych emiratach (ręczne szukanie 24.11, bez godzin i cen – źródła niezgodne)

places.name: Masfout Castle
places.description: 19th-century watchtower fort on a hilltop in Ajman's mountain enclave of Masfout, with wide views over the Hajar Mountains.

places.name: Masfout Museum
places.description: Small local history museum in the mountain enclave of Masfout, showing how people lived and farmed in the Hajar foothills.

places.name: Masfout Gate
places.description: Landmark gateway to Masfout and a starting point for the hiking and mountain-bike routes in Ajman's cooler mountain enclave.

places.name: Manama Museum
places.description: Heritage museum in a restored fort in Al Manama, Ajman's farming enclave at the foot of the Hajar Mountains.

places.name: Ajman Dhow Yard
places.description: Working boatyard on Ajman Creek where traditional wooden dhows are still built and repaired by hand.

places.name: Al Zorah Mangrove Kayaking
places.description: Guided kayak trips through the mangrove channels of Al Zorah Nature Reserve, home to flamingos and other birdlife.

places.name: Al Zorah Golf Club
places.description: 18-hole championship golf course laid out among the mangroves and lagoons of Al Zorah.

places.name: Al Safia Park
places.description: Seafront public park in Ajman with lawns and walking paths; the start and finish of the Ajman Half Marathon.

places.name: Marsa Ajman
places.description: Waterfront promenade with restaurants and cafes, popular for an evening walk by the water.

places.name: Ajman Fish Market
places.description: Lively traditional fish market, busiest when the day's catch comes in; the Gold Souk is close by.

places.name: Umm Al Quwain Fort and Museum
places.description: Fort from 1768, once home of the ruling family, now a museum with finds from the Ed-Dur and Tell Abraq archaeological sites.

places.name: Falaj Al Mualla Fort
places.description: 19th-century fort and watchtowers in the oasis town of Falaj Al Mualla, about 50 km inland, with a small museum.

places.name: Kite Beach Center
places.description: Laid-back private beach with a restaurant, kitesurfing and paddleboarding, plus guided kayak and paddleboard tours of the mangroves.

places.name: Umm Al Quwain Open Beach
places.description: Long, quiet public beach, a calm alternative to the busier Dubai and Sharjah shores.

places.name: Al Khor Waterfront
places.description: Waterfront promenade on the lagoon, the emirate's main spot for public celebrations and fireworks.

places.name: Al Labsah Camel Racetrack
places.description: Desert camel-racing track on the Umm Al Quwain border; races are held on winter mornings.

places.name: Fujairah Museum
places.description: Archaeology and heritage museum near Fujairah Fort with Bronze Age finds from across the emirate.

places.name: Al Hayl Castle
places.description: 19th-century castle in a mountain valley, once a seat of Fujairah's ruling family.

places.name: Bithnah Fort
places.description: Mud-brick fort guarding the old route through the Hajar Mountains in Wadi Ham.

places.name: Sheikh Zayed Mosque Fujairah
places.description: The UAE's second-largest mosque, with six 100-metre minarets. Non-Muslim visitors can admire it from outside.

places.name: Ain Al Madhab Gardens
places.description: Shady park at the foot of the mountains built around mineral springs, with separate pools for men, women and children.

places.name: Umbrella Beach
places.description: Popular family beach on the Fujairah seafront with shallow water, cafes and food trucks.

places.name: Al Aqah Beach
places.description: The east coast's best-known beach strip, facing Snoopy Island, with snorkelling and diving in the Gulf of Oman.

places.name: Masafi Friday Market
places.description: Roadside market in the mountains selling fruit, pottery, carpets and souvenirs. Open every day despite the name.

places.name: Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Al Nahyan Mosque
places.description: Al Ain's grand mosque, one of the largest in the UAE and a landmark of the city.

places.name: Souq Al Qattara
places.description: Traditional market on the palm-lined road between the Al Qattara and Al Jimi oases, next to Al Qattara Arts Centre.

places.name: Bida Bint Saud
places.description: Rocky outcrop with Bronze and Iron Age tombs, part of Al Ain's UNESCO World Heritage sites.

places.name: Bait Mohammed Bin Khalifa
places.description: Restored 1958 house of Sheikh Mohammed bin Khalifa Al Nahyan, showing life in Al Ain before the oil era.
